The Blade's revelation, card by card

The new first pass under your EV rulings: ten cards in the new order, each label climbing the ladder (in nature, in a life, in you, a moment you'd notice, one thing to try), five named ideas on the first pass. The frames use the real paintings and signs. The layout is a sketch for the design session to build properly; what you're ruling here is the words and the order.

Rule each card by its code: "V0 A" keeps every draft line on that card, "V0 B" takes every B option, or mix line by line ("V1 A, contrast B"). Locked lines are already ruled and aren't asked again. Lines marked as shared are ruled with the shared batch for all ten stems.

The Blade

Metal is the element of clarity. It sorts, cuts and decides.

As a Blade, you are that edge in a person. You might notice:

  • You see the flaw in a plan before anyone asks.
  • Being vague feels worse to you than being wrong.
  • People come to you when they need the unsoftened truth.

People see someone sharp and certain. Inside, you are checking every word for whether it is true.

You say what others soften, then quietly pay for being the one who did.

How you run

You run Overfueled: more comes into you than goes out.

You take in, prepare and carry more than you let out. It makes you steady under pressure. It also means energy builds up with nowhere to go, and it comes out as impatience.

Try this: let one thing out each day: a decision, a sentence, a finished draft.
